title: CircularQuay motion-study integration inventory
assetPolicy: Local SVG assets only; no runtime icon network requests. Logos are illustrative ecosystem examples and do not assert a supported, qualified, configured or connected adapter.

provenance.revision: develop branch at download; each retained asset is SHA-256 pinned below.

devicon.note: Used only where the named Simple Icons vector was unavailable; a shared vendor mark preserves the distinct role label.

modelContextProtocol.note: Official protocol mark; not an adapter or conformance claim.

colorMetadata.method: For current Simple Icons assets, the verified metadata hex is applied as an SVG root fill. upstreamSha256 records the unmodified upstream byte digest; sha256 is the retained coloured local asset digest. Historical marks use their corresponding pinned pre-removal metadata. Devicon, official MCP and non-brand local assets retain their source or documented color.
